# tebib_snapshot_schedule (Resource)

Takes snapshots of a VM on a schedule and deletes the old ones. Snapshots it took are kept when the schedule is deleted (delete them yourself). At least one of `retention_count` and `retention_days` is required.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tebib_snapshot_schedule" "nightly" {
  name            = "nightly"
  vm_id           = tebib_vm.db.id
  frequency       = "daily"
  hour            = 2
  minute          = 30
  timezone        = "Africa/Nairobi"
  retention_count = 7
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `frequency` (String) `hourly` (at `minute`), `daily` (at `hour`:`minute`), `weekly` (on `weekday` at `hour`:`minute`) or `custom` (`cron`).
- `name` (String) Name, unique among the project's snapshot schedules. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `vm_id` (String) VM to snapshot. Changing it replaces the schedule.

### Optional

- `cron` (String) For frequency `custom` only: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week, e.g. `30 2 * * 1-5`. At most once an hour (the minute is one number).
- `description` (String) Description, at most 255 characters. Default: empty.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether it takes snapshots. Default: `true`.
- `hour` (Number) Hour of the day (0-23), for daily and weekly. Default: 0.
- `minute` (Number) Minute of the hour (0-59). Default: 0.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (`p-...`). Default: the provider's `project`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `retention_count` (Number) Keep the newest N snapshots this schedule took (1-100).
- `retention_days` (Number) Delete snapshots this schedule took once they are N days old (1-365).
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags (key-value pairs). IAM policies can match them. Default: none.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `timezone` (String) IANA time zone of the times, e.g. `Africa/Nairobi`. Default: `UTC`.
- `weekday` (Number) Day of the week for weekly, 0 = Sunday to 6 = Saturday. Default: 0.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339).
- `effective_cron` (String) The cron expression the schedule runs on, presets included.
- `failures` (Number) Runs in a row that didn't succeed.
- `id` (String) Snapshot schedule ID (`ssch-...`).
- `next_run_at` (String) The next run (UTC, RFC 3339); null while disabled.
- `snapshot_count` (Number) Live snapshots this schedule took.
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state: `active` once ready (or `error`).
- `status_message` (String) What the platform last said about the resource.
- `trn` (String) TebibHost resource name (TRN), for IAM policies.

### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <schedule_id>, optionally with <project_id>/ in front.
terraform import tebib_snapshot_schedule.nightly ssch-abc123
```
